name: Count Of Subarrays With Equal Number Of Zeroes And Ones
statement:
1. You are given an array that contains only 0s and 1s.
2. You have to find the count of subarrays with equal number of 0s and 1s.
inputFormat:
A number N
arr1
arr2.. N numbers
outputFormat: A number representing count of subarrays with equal number of 0s and 1s.
